decisions_for_lead: 1. PlanExtensions::validate (extensions.rs) still adds envelope operators (Blend-If, adjustment, effects, feather, EffectsNested) from every entry, including entries addressed to unreachable groups. Evidence that backends disagree: render-cpu ExtPrep::build (plan_sink/extended.rs:199) prepares every envelope entry with no reachability filter, render-gpu looks an entry up per executed layer (plan_sink.rs:486). Making the envelope reachable-only here would admit a plan render-cpu then prepares (and may refuse) entry by entry, so it needs a backend decision first; not changed.

2. Backends adopting caller limits: render-cpu plan_sink.rs:1395 (admit) and :1427 (admit_extended), render-gpu plan_sink.rs:964 and :965 call the default-limits entry points. ExecuteRequest cannot gain a field (dependants build it by struct literal). Options: a PlanLimits field on each backend struct set by a builder method and passed to admit_with_limits / admit_extended_with_limits, or a RenderBackend::execute_with_limits default method. Not done here (backend crates are out of scope).
follow_ups: 1. render-cpu / render-gpu: adopt admit_with_limits and admit_extended_with_limits behind a host-configurable PlanLimits (decisions_for_lead item 2).

2. composite lower_render_plan.rs:922 and tests/render_plan_lowering.rs:2072 call validate(&PlanLimits::default()): unchanged and correct (default limits); composite's own lowering limits (max_steps, depth) are a separate budget.

3. PlanLimits covers nodes, layers and depth only; the envelope budgets MAX_EFFECTS_PER_LAYER (64) and MAX_EFFECTS_PER_PLAN (4096) in PlanExtensions::validate are fixed constants. Tightening them needs a new field on PlanLimits (pub fields, built by literal by hosts: add it with a builder, not a breaking field) or an envelope-limits argument.
4. PlanExtensions envelope operator collection reachable-only: decisions_for_lead item 1.
